session_note: VA's 2026 regular General Assembly session (60-day, even-year session) convened 2026-01-14 and adjourned sine die 2026-03-14. Per Va. Const. Art. V Sec. 6, the Governor then had 30 days to act on bills, i.e. a deadline of 2026-04-13 - this is why the enacted bills below show 'approved 2026-04-13' (it is the constitutional signing deadline, not a reconvened-session date). The constitutionally separate reconvened (veto/amendment) session for 2026 was held 2026-04-22 (the sixth Wednesday after adjournment), confirmed via LIS's own Session API; no bill in this set required reconvened-session action since none were amended or vetoed by the Governor in 2026. VA House of Delegates members serve 2-year terms elected in odd years; the term covering the 2026 and 2027 sessions began January 2026 (after the Nov 2025 election), so a bill 'Continued to 2027' from the 2026 session remains alive within the SAME term (bill_status_category carried_over). By contrast, HB338 (2024) and SB288 (2024) belong to the prior 2024-2025 term (elected Nov 2023); that term, and its 2025 session, are now over, so any bill left in committee/continued without further action is dead (failed_died), not carried over into the new 2026-2027 term.
